metadata.description: # Breeding Smarter synthetic dog pedigree dataset (v1)  **All animals are synthetic. Any resemblance to real dogs, kennels or registration numbers is accidental.**  A calibrated synthetic registry of three fictional dog breeds (1935 to 2026), generated by the open Breeding Smarter simulator, with a separate ground truth (realised inbreeding, true breeding values, all genotypes) for benchmarking pedigree analytics, mate matching and rule compliance.  - `registry/`: what a kennel club would record (153,641 animals,   23,924 litters, health and DNA tests, EBVs). Parquet and CSV. - `truth/`: ground truth for every simulated animal (275,189). - `validation/`: calibration targets vs simulated values and figures. - `datasheet.md`: full datasheet; `data_dictionary.md`: every field.  Licence CC BY 4.0. DOI TODO-DOI. Code: https://github.com/TODO/breeding-smarter.
